relationships.subject: C fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that GABAergic neurons were mainly activated by monosynaptic C fiber which accounted for 53.0% of total evoked postsynaptic potentials

relationships.subject: Adelta fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: GABAergic neurons not only received excitatory drive from peripheral Aβ, Aδ and C fibers, but also received inhibitory inputs driven by Aδ and C fibers

relationships.subject: glycinergic interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: C fiber driven feed-forward inhibition onto GABAergic interneurons was mainly glycinergic, while Aδ driven feed-forward inhibition onto GABAergic interneurons was rather both glycinergic and GABAergic

relationships.subject: C fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: spinal GABAergic inhibitory neurons are under feedforward inhibitory control driven by primary C and Aδ fibers

key_findings: Spinal Gad2+ GABAergic neurons (mainly lamina II-III) receive monosynaptic excitation chiefly from C fibers and also Adelta and Abeta fibers.
They also receive feed-forward inhibition driven by C (mainly glycinergic) and Adelta (mixed GABA/glycine) fibers, but none driven by Abeta fibers.
